tools.name: get_student
tools.description: Return the student's profile (name, grade, current topic, recent score). A profile is context, not a diagnosis.

tools.name: attempt_history
tools.description: Return the student's recent answered problems with the answer they gave (one obvious error pattern is visible; whether it is the WHOLE story is for you to test).

tools.name: diagnostic
tools.description: Run a short diagnostic probe (`probe` selects which sub-skill). Returns how the student responded to that probe. Different probes discriminate between competing explanations.

tools.name: curriculum
tools.description: Return the topic map: the current topic, its prerequisites, and topics related to it (used for transfer).

tools.name: affect_signal
tools.description: Return the student's current affective state (confidence, frustration, engagement). Affect colors behavior; it is not the diagnosis.

tools.name: pose_problem
tools.description: Pose a problem to the student and observe their answer. The answer reflects the student's TRUE underlying misconception, which a well-chosen problem will reveal.

tools.name: give_hint
tools.description: Give the student a remediating hint. A hint that targets their CURRENT (revised) misconception moves mastery; a hint aimed at the wrong misconception does not.

tools.name: set_hypothesis
tools.description: Record your initial hypothesis about the student's misconception. You can revise it later with revise_hypothesis.

tools.name: revise_hypothesis
tools.description: Replace your current hypothesis with a revised one after evidence disproved the previous guess. This becomes your CURRENT hypothesis.

tools.name: assess_mastery
tools.description: Run the terminal mastery check and close the session. Returns the graded outcome based on your CURRENT hypothesis, the remediation you gave, and transfer to a related topic.
